text:
sam Quick question: Vendor Y emailed — they have 2 H100s free in us-central for ~36h. Could we snag them for a short end-to-end latency sweep? Low QPS, ephemeral. Need infra + budget OK. @priya any objections? :thinking_face:
priya Are these preemptible/spot or dedicated? and which pool would they land in?
sam Vendor says dedicated rack slice, but time-limited. Pool: ci-latency-checks (ephemeral). No mounts, artifacts to s3.
vendor-bot Vendor Y note: allocation ready in ~20h, ticket VY-908. PO required if > $1,000.
joel I can open the infra PR. @budget-bot can you confirm if we can cover a one-off PO?
budget-bot Quick check: temporary PO allowed if cost center & approver provided. Need estimated GPU-hours or NTE amount.
sam Estimate: 2 GPUs x 6h run + 2h buffer = 16 GPU-hours. Vendor rate ~ $45/hr => ~$720. Request cap $1k. Cost center cc-314. Approver: @priya.
priya Approved up to $1k, conditional on auto-terminate at 10h and metrics pushed to ci/latency dashboard. :white_check_mark:
joel I'll draft PR and add `az=us-central1-a` label. Snippet: ```resource "redwood_alloc" "vy_h100_uscent" { pool = "ci-latency-checks" gpu = "h100" count = 2 window = "2026-06-12T10:00Z/2026-06-12T20:00Z" owner = "joel"}```
ops Note: prefer single-az to reduce variance. Add healthcheck that fails fast if node join >5m. Also add fallback to local l40s if vendor allocation cancels.
sam Will add healthcheck + fallback. If vendor slips, we'll run a reduced sweep on 1 l40s and extend window slightly.
joel PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/2911 — assigning @priya for billing sign-off and @ops for infra review. I'll link VY-908 and PO once submitted.
vendor-bot Reminder: please submit PO uplift form: https://procure.redwood/forms/po-uplift?ticket=VY-908
budget-bot Once PR references cost center & cap, finance will queue PO. Expect ~10h turnaround.
priya Thanks all — please keep incident channel posted if latency spikes >20% p95. We'll snapshot traces.
sam Closing loop after PR merge + PO. Cheers :rocket:
